    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Transformer 从零开始</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>资料：</p>
<ul>
<li>① <a href="https://jalammar.github.io/illustrated-transformer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">The Illustrated Transformer - Jay Alammar</a></li>
<li>② <a href="https://machinelearningmastery.com/category/building-transformer-models/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Building Transformer Models - Jason Brownlee</a></li>
<li>③ <a href="https://d2l.ai/chapter_attention-mechanisms-and-transformers/transformer.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Transformer - Dive into Deep Learning</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="从零开始">从零开始</h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://machinelearningmastery.com/building-transformer-models-from-scratch-with-pytorch-10-day-mini-course/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">2025-10 / Building Transformer Models from Scratch with PyTorch</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="环境">环境</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">conda create -n torch python=3.12
conda activate torch

# Install PyTorch (CPU version)
pip install torch torchvision
# Install PyTorch with CUDA (version &lt;= nvidia-smi shown)
#  https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally
pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130
</code></pre>
<h3 id="运行">运行</h3>
<ul>
<li>代码：<a href="https://github.com/ikuokuo/start-deep-learning/blob/master/practice/Transformer/build_transformer.py" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">build_transformer.py</a></li>
<li>关键：Decoder-only, RoPE, GQA, MoE, SwiGLU</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cd start-deep-learning/practice/Transformer
pip install -r requirements.txt
python build_transformer.py
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>BATCH_SIZE 4, 可以改 32，如果显存够大。我呢，训不太动 😢</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="进化线">进化线</h2>
<p>之后是概括，给一些关键词。基此问一下 AI，能得到更好的回答呢。</p>
<p>例如，DeepSeek 归纳了 5 条核心进化线，</p>
<p>如果把大模型比作一辆车：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Attention</strong> 是 <strong>引擎</strong>（GQA/MLA 是省油技术）；</li>
<li><strong>Normalization</strong> 是 <strong>底盘悬挂</strong>（RMSNorm 保证行驶稳定）；</li>
<li><strong>激活函数</strong> 是 <strong>燃油标号</strong>（SwiGLU 是高标号汽油）；</li>
<li><strong>位置编码</strong> 是 <strong>导航系统</strong>（RoPE 让你知道该去哪）；</li>
<li><strong>架构</strong> 是 <strong>车身设计</strong>（Decode-Only 最终统一了赛道）。</li>
</ul>
<p>这些进化线相互配合，才有了今天又长、又快、又强的 LLM。</p>
<h3 id="架构进化">架构进化</h3>
<p>Encoder-Decoder: 原始，适合 Seq2Seq 任务</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://d2l.ai/_images/transformer.svg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://jalammar.github.io/images/t/The_transformer_encoder_decoder_stack.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>Decoder-only (Causal): 当前，经过 Scaling Laws 验证</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://machinelearningmastery.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Decoder-Only-Model-622x1024.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="attention-进化">Attention 进化</h3>
<p>KV Cache 优化，</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">注意力机制</th>
<th style="text-align: left">KV Cache 量级</th>
<th style="text-align: left">表达能力</th>
<th style="text-align: left">核心思想</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">MHA (多头注意力)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">最大 (H)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">最强</td>
<td style="text-align: left">每个头独立看世界</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">MQA (多查询注意力)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">最小 (1)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">较弱</td>
<td style="text-align: left">所有人用同一套记忆</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">GQA (分组查询注意力)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">中等 (G)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">可控</td>
<td style="text-align: left">分组共享，折中之道</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left">MLA (多头潜在注意力)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">极小 (≈1)</td>
<td style="text-align: left">强</td>
<td style="text-align: left">压缩记忆，解耦计算</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>计算模式优化，</p>
<ul>
<li>Sliding Window Attention (滑动窗口注意力)</li>
<li>FlashAttention: 改进 GPU 的访存算法</li>
<li>Sparse Attention (稀疏注意力)</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="位置编码进化">位置编码进化</h3>
<p>让模型理解顺序，</p>
<ul>
<li>绝对位置编码</li>
<li>相对位置编码</li>
<li>RoPE (旋转位置编码): 当前主流，更好的长度外推</li>
<li>ALiBi</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="激活函数进化">激活函数进化</h3>
<p>增强非线性，</p>
<ul>
<li>ReLU</li>
<li>GeLU</li>
<li>SwiGLU</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="结语">结语</h2>
<p>开篇的资料 ① 适合入门，资料 ② 适合实践，都是超级棒的文章，值得学习 👍</p>
